# Traffic Drop in Sahel due to Transport Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SAH-01-B`
- **Confidence:** high (Directly evidenced maintenance window matching the timing of site outages and traffic drops, with changes, external events, and other root causes checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-21 01:15 to 2026-09-21 04:45
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-21 01:19
- **Affected:** S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012

## Summary

Routine transport network maintenance window executed on the fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B, causing a service interruption on three dependent sites.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012) for 3.5 hours during the transport network maintenance window. All services recovered completely upon maintenance completion.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-21 01:15: Traffic, active users and availability drop alert begins on 3 sites in SAH (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012). [T1, ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 01:19: Planned maintenance window MW-0007 starts on transport fiber link LNK-SAH-01-B. [T3, MW-0007, LNK-SAH-01-B]
- 2026-09-21 01:23: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on sites S-SAH-012, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-001. [T2, ALM-000455, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:43: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-SAH-002 and S-SAH-001. [T2, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- 2026-09-21 04:44: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SAH-012. [T2, ALM-000455]
- 2026-09-21 04:45: Detector alert ALR-0031 for traffic and availability drop ends. [T1, ALR-0031]
- 2026-09-21 04:52: Planned maintenance window MW-0007 completed on LNK-SAH-01-B. [T3, MW-0007]

## Evidence

- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on three sites in SAH (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012) from 2026-09-21 01:15 to 2026-09-21 04:45. [T1, ALR-0031]
- Critical SITE_DOWN alarms were triggered for S-SAH-012, S-SAH-002, and S-SAH-001 between 2026-09-21 01:23 and 2026-09-21 04:44. [T2, ALM-000455, ALM-000456, ALM-000457]
- Routine transport network maintenance window MW-0007 ran on LNK-SAH-01-B from 2026-09-21 01:19 to 2026-09-21 04:52. [T3, MW-0007]
- No unplanned changes were performed on the affected sites and their parents during the window. [T4]
- No external events were recorded for the Sahel region during the window. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SAH-01-B: confirmed. Maintenance window MW-0007 precisely matches the timing of the transport fiber link outage and subsequent site dropouts. [T3, MW-0007]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or their parents during the relevant time window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: No changes were executed on S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-012 or their parents during the incident window, ruling out bad changes as the root cause.
- T6: No external events occurred in the region during the incident window, ruling out external factors.

## Recommended actions

- Ensure post-maintenance verification scripts validate full traffic recovery across dependent sites immediately after transport windows close.
